title: Youth Republic Leadership Opens Nationwide Interim Leadership Nominations
author: YRL Interim National Secretariat
excerpt: Nominations are officially open nationwide for 11 Interim National Ministerial portfolios and 16 Interim Regional Ministers to establish foundational governance across Ghana.
content: The interim leadership of Youth Republic Leadership (YRL) is pleased to announce the official opening of nationwide nominations for foundational interim leadership positions across the Republic of Ghana.

Youth Republic Leadership is recruiting committed, ethical, and forward-thinking young leaders aged 18 to 40 to establish our foundational interim governance structure. In strict accordance with our founding charter, interim positions are voluntary and non-partisan, dedicated exclusively to youth advocacy, leadership development, and community transformation.

Open positions include 11 Interim National Portfolios: Chief of Staff, Minister for Education, Minister for Youth Employment and Entrepreneurship, Minister for Finance, Minister for Research, Science and Technology, Minister for Communications, Minister for Health, Minister for Agriculture, Minister for Gender, Women and Social Protection, Minister for Local Government and Community Development, and Attorney-General and Minister for Justice.

Additionally, 16 Interim Regional Ministers are being recruited to spearhead regional coordination and grassroots engagement across all sixteen administrative regions of Ghana: Ahafo, Ashanti, Bono, Bono East, Central, Eastern, Greater Accra, North East, Northern, Oti, Savannah, Upper East, Upper West, Volta, Western, and Western North.

YRL firmly reiterates that all nominations are 100% FREE. The organisation does not charge any processing, application, or vetting fees under any circumstances. Youth aged 18–40 who share our core principle that 'Leadership is service, not privilege' are encouraged to submit their formal nominations through the official portal.
